style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontColor=#8c8f98;fontSize=11;fontFamily=IBM Plex Sans;spacing=0;" value="The author pushes a source bundle with locked dependencies. A native compile task builds it into a component, or the workflow reuses the stored one when the compile-cache key (source hash, lockfile hash, componentize-py version, WIT contract version, entry) matches, before it places a compile task. Each execution gets a fresh instance of that component in stock wasmtime, as a plain command component with an input file, result files (results.xml in wdf.sim.v1 at every level), an exit code and a stderr heartbeat. The aggregate is a native task and is not a WASM component. Limits apply to compile and execution alike." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="72" width="920" x="20" y="966" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: The author pushes a source bundle with locked dependencies. A native compile task builds it into a component, or the workflow reuses the stored one when the compile-cache key (source hash, lockfile hash, componentize-py version, WIT contract version, entry) matches, before it places a compile task. Each execution gets a fresh instance of that component in stock wasmtime, as a plain command component with an input file, result files (results.xml in wdf.sim.v1 at every level), an exit code and a stderr heartbeat. The aggregate is a native task and is not a WASM component. Limits apply to compile and execution alike.
